narrative.overview: Always-light social walking app: cool gray canvas, white surfaces, charcoal text, orange contained actions, peach selections, and golden avatar accents. Palette direction follows the user-supplied Stompers screenshots; existing layout is preserved. Android physical-device validation remains outstanding.
keyCharacteristics: Always-light neutral surfaces with orange, peach, and golden accents.
Flat, readable people lists and explicit invitation states.
Platform typography, outlined fields, and restrained primary actions.
A small original geometric footprint mark.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Keep each foreground with its corresponding container in the active theme; do not carry light-mode ink onto dark-mode surfaces.

rules.name: The Role Before Size Rule
rules.body: Extend Paper text variants and existing overrides rather than introducing unrelated heading sizes.

dos: **Do** pair semantic foreground and container colors in the current theme.
**Do** extend Paper text variants and the existing single-column spacing rhythm.
**Do** preserve divided people rows and explicit action labels.
**Do** keep demo context visible and identify sample people.
**Do** validate Android touch targets, font scaling, keyboard behavior, and fixed light appearance on a device.
donts: **Don't** treat surrogate web captures as native visual approval.
**Don't** promote inherited lavender elevation tones or unmeasured default action sizes into brand rules.
**Don't** invent walking statistics or dashboard components absent from this implementation.
**Don't** treat Stride or the footprint as an approved final identity.
